CA.rationale: Content (red at coordinates) is explicitly linked to a processing/origin condition (command_estimate) for the same candidate/node/time.

COD.rationale: Content (red/blue coordinates), an explicit organization/presentation cue (grid orientation), and a distinct origin/status entry are all present and bound to p0/current/n3/current in the model-organization scope.

A.rationale: A processing/origin condition (command_estimate) is explicitly associated with the node's reported content at the same referent/time.

C.rationale: Identifies specific content (colour-tagged coordinate sets) and their attributes explicitly.

D.rationale: The report separates identified content (red/blue coordinates) from a distinct origin/status field for the same node/time.

O.rationale: States how content is presented/organized (grid orientation and explicit coordinate placement) for the identified node/time.
